lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Cr6Co4O16 (reduced formula MgCr3(CoO4)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral Cr and Co centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside 4-coordinate Mg and a 2-coordinate Cr environment. Corner- and edge-sharing relations are observed among Cr and Co octahedra, with additional edge-sharing between Cr octahedra and between Co octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
